node.title: Re^7: Switch.pm Failure
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
i would have done Switch sub {...}

Ok, but without the sub is also not uncommon, for example I'd say [mod://Try::Tiny]'s sub try (&;@) clearly looks better when written try { ... } catch { ... };.

In regards to your other [id://1182833|post]:

the whole (logical-test) && do { process-stmts} ; setup while legal is very "un-perlish"

I disagree, I think it's very perlish, in fact probably "too" perlish! ;-)
